overview: Purple Material 3 surfaces frame an evidence-led inspection workflow. Bricolage Grotesque, rounded touch targets, and readable evidence keep operators oriented from capture through engineer review.
rules: Purple signals workflow selection and primary actions.
Red and amber retain quality severity meaning.
Body text is 16px; supporting labels are at least 14px.
Use soft offset shadows and restrained gloss; protect text contrast.
Keep the part image, finding, and next action together.
